name: Burj al Arab
description: The Arabian Star, also known as the Burj Al Arab Hotel, is located in Dubai, the Emirate of Dubai, the United Arab Emirates in the Middle East. It is the tallest hotel in the world and was the world's first 7-star hotel. The overall appearance is like a sail filled with wind. The architectural style has a strong Islamic style. The extremely luxurious decoration is perfectly combined with high-tech craftsmanship and building materials. Even the late top fashion designer Versace was shocked by its luxurious royal suite. After a good night's sleep, everyone will marvel at it.
